# Ashlr MD

> Open-source Markdown app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Agents install one command, call a CLI that prints JSON, and drive the live document over MCP.

Ashlr MD is a desktop app plus `mdopen` and the `mdopener-mcp` server. People read and edit `.md` files. Agents open, edit, export, and request a human review.

Ashlr MD is part of Ashlr: Phantom and its ecosystem form a fully autonomous, code-first, agent-native software factory, run by agents with the human as a passive board member, chasing open source RSI (recursive self improvement). Ashlr MD is the factory's Markdown surface, where an agent hands a document to a person. Agents maintain this repository too.

The install command, from a checkout on macOS or Linux:

```bash
SKIP_APP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/install.sh
```

Then:

```bash
mdopener-mcp doctor --json
mdopener-mcp setup --local --json
mdopener-mcp --ashlr-handshake --json
claude mcp add --scope user ashlr-md "$(command -v mdopener-mcp)"
codex mcp add ashlr-md -- "$(command -v mdopener-mcp)"
python3 scripts/connect-cursor.py
```

Repository links below are relative to https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/, including in the copy served at md.ashlr.ai.

## CLI

- [doctor --fix](docs/doctor-fix.md): `mdopener-mcp doctor --fix --json` previews repairs and writes nothing

- [Local AI](docs/local-ai.md): `localInference`, offline mode, and base URL rules
- [Phantom](docs/PHANTOM.md): how Phantom calls `mdopen`

## Ecosystem

- [Part of Ashlr](README.md#part-of-ashlr): the mission and how Ashlr MD fits it
- [Phantom](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom): `phm`, the agent workbench; it opens its inbox and digest in Ashlr MD
- [Phantom Secrets](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom-secrets): `phantom`, `phm_` placeholders for API keys
- [Locus](https://github.com/ashlrai/locus): `locus`, one account per agent session
- [Lexicon](https://lexicon.ashlr.ai): `lexicon`, dictation corrections
- [Ashlr Stack](https://stack.ashlr.ai): `stack`, service provisioning
- [ashlr-plugin](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/): token-efficiency tools
